title: Candidate Engagement
summary: Chatbot, WhatsApp and email follow-ups that keep every candidate informed.
headline: Candidates who always know *where they stand*
lede: Questions answered at any hour, reminders sent before anyone has to chase, and interviews booked without a single back-and-forth email.

capabilities.title: AI Chatbot
capabilities.body: Answers candidate questions about the role, the process and their application status, on your careers page or in chat.
points: Answers drawn from your approved content
Hands over to a recruiter when it should
Pre-screens with a few structured questions

capabilities.title: Automated Follow-Ups
capabilities.body: Nudges for incomplete applications, pending assessments and unsigned offers, sent on the schedule you choose.
points: Triggered by stage and by silence
Stops the moment the candidate acts
Tone and timing set per role

capabilities.title: WhatsApp Integration
capabilities.body: Reach candidates where they already reply. Applications, reminders and scheduling all work inside a WhatsApp chat.
points: Apply and book interviews in the chat
Conversation history saved to the profile

capabilities.title: Email Automation
capabilities.body: Templates for every stage that fill in the details themselves and send from the recruiter’s own address.

capabilities.title: Interview Scheduling
capabilities.body: Candidates pick a slot from the panel’s real availability, and the invite, video link and reminders follow automatically.
points: Teams, Zoom and Google Meet links added

outcomes.label: answers to candidate questions, in chat or WhatsApp
channels in one thread: WhatsApp, email and web chat
emails needed to book or move an interview
